pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
clip_note: a parent or the ranger notices her: the shoulders jump up, the hands jerk into fists and the head snaps toward the light; the game holds the last frame ~1 s, then fades
plays_over: girl_stand_lower, girl_sneak_lower and girl_side_step_lower (the last two moved by their upper_offset); the body turns as one toward the aim (MOVEMENT_PLAN)
head: no head sheet: draw a girl_head_poses frame moved by head_offset (frame 2, 0 deg, at [0, 0] is the idle head exactly)
head_turn: head_pose_deg 35: draw girl_head_poses frame 1 (+35) or frame 3 (-35), whichever turns her face toward the light, at head_offset (mirror head_offset's x for -35)
